date_scope_check.qualification_retained: REC50-R47-002-P1: The first returning UN convoy is confirmed on September 19, 2023 by the UN briefing, full Logistics Cluster meeting minutes and AP field reporting. The Security Council mandate expired July 10, but the precise first cancelled operational service is not independently timed. August and September consent steps are not actual convoy returns. AP’s reference to alternative-route use since July 9 is not used to replace the UN authorization chronology. Other aid providers, commerce and passengers remain outside this phase. The original UN briefing is available as a substantive indexed extract and its direct body remains blocked; the Logistics Cluster PDF and AP republication were read in full. The UN’s explicit first-convoy-since-July-10 statement establishes a prolonged absence of this particular convoy service and supports greater-than-24-hour eligibility; uncertainty over the first missed scheduled convoy does not reduce it to an unknown-duration same-day event.
